assumptions: Golden-test assumption: landing performance and landing distance are suitable for the stated A350 test options.
Golden-test method boundary: the FCOM Performance section supplies the approved RLD/LD/FLD and EFB method, but this fixture does not create airport-specific runway, LDA or landing-distance values.
A Code 4E aerodrome is not itself treated as proof of landing performance.
Golden-test assumption: the NOTAMs contained in the SQ23 Lido CFP are current and valid for the frozen scenario snapshot.
Golden-test assumption: the current MEL items declared in the SQ23 CFP, including their operational conditions, are valid for the frozen scenario snapshot.
Scenario condition: stable one-engine-inoperative diversion case; no continuing fire, severe damage or additional system degradation is introduced.
The CFP weather package is used as the desktop-scenario weather within its stated validity and projected arrival times; it is not represented as live operational weather outside this test.
QRH Rev 18 currency and aircraft effectivity must be reconciled against the operator's current controlled library before production use.

evidence.claim: SQ23 is planned KJFK-WSSS on 25.07.26 using A350-941 registration 9V-SGE.
ETP1-1D occurs at ACTM 03:18 near N56 26.2 W036 35.7, with CYQX and EINN shown as the EDTO diversion pair.

Helpyou applies the SIA OM descending operational-document priority sequence, preserves same-level documents without inventing sub-priority, uses the latest revision where copies differ, and retains any valid lower-authority requirement that is more restrictive.

Following an engine failure, the commander protects terrain during drift-down, selects an appropriate engine-out strategy, and may choose an adequate EDTO alternate or another airport considered suitable under the prevailing circumstances; nearest is not automatically most suitable.

A350 in-flight landing performance following a diversion or failure is assessed with the approved EFB using factored in-flight landing distance; in an emergency, if the factor is disregarded, the in-flight landing distance must remain shorter than LDA.

FCTM teaching material supports discussion of EDTO weather at estimated time of use, diversion procedures, operational control, task priority and crew coordination, but remains below OM, FCOM and MEL in the OM authority sequence.
